stories.title: Family increasing reward for information on Union City homicide
stories.summary: According to authorities, Christopher Kindle was shot multiple times on the evening of Nov. 25, 2018, at the Shannon Lake apartments on Buffington Road.

stories.title: Athens police say no evidence found of reported rape at downtown bar on Halloween night
stories.summary: The update comes after a woman reported being raped by three men during a Halloween event at the country bar and dance club, according to a police report.

stories.title: Driver charged with DUI after hitting pedestrian in crosswalk near Tanner Health, police say
stories.summary: According to authorities, the pedestrian sustained head injuries and was transported to an Atlanta-area hospital for medical treatment.

stories.title: Second former Norcross police officer arrested for allegedly misusing Flock license plate reader
stories.summary: Tyler Reiss, 32, faces 14 felony and misdemeanor counts after the GBI says he accessed the system multiple times for non-law enforcement purposes.

stories.title: Dragon Con co-founder sentenced to prison for first time since arrest in 2000
stories.summary: Kramer was first arrested in 2000 for molesting three boys inside a Duluth home and eventually entered a plea under Georgia's First Offender's Act in 2013.

stories.title: Deputies in Bartow County investigate suspicious death of Cartersville woman
stories.summary: According to authorities, on the morning of Nov. 16, a caller reported finding a deceased woman in the area of Dogwood Trail SW off Rolling Hills Drive SW.

stories.title: Two high school students dead in Coweta County crash, officials say
stories.summary: It happened on Hwy. 29 near Coweta Heard Road and the roadway is shut down.

stories.title: 4-year-old critically injured, multiple others hurt after woman fleeing pursuit causes crash in Loganville: authorities
stories.summary: The injured child was air-lifted to Atlanta for treatment.

stories.title: Atlanta City Council advances plan for Moores Mill Road bridge replacement, citywide bridge study
stories.summary: The bridge at Moores Mill Road over Peachtree Creek partially collapsed when it was hit by a heavy vehicle on October 20.

stories.title: Small plane crashes in Pickens County after landing, minor injuries reported: FAA
stories.summary: The Pickens County Sheriff's Office said it happened along Hwy. 53 West near Woodstock Church of Jasper.

stories.title: Crews tackle structure fire at Buckhead event/party venue
stories.summary: The fire appeared to be engulfing Buck's Sports Barn, a sports and activity venue along Peachtree Road.

stories.title: Boil water advisory issued after water main break interrupts service in downtown Roswell, officials say
stories.summary: Customers are advised to bring water to a boil and allow it to cool before using it for drinking, brushing teeth or cooking.
